capabilities: browse and filter tasks in a two-pane list and detail view
define custom task fields per project
organize tasks into projects with settings notes and ID prefixes
comment on tasks with author and timestamp
sort, group, and hide done tasks
extras: The manifest notes that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs cover settings and file format in detail but include no usage walkthrough.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to track tasks with custom fields, statuses, projects, and comments; it only offers basic task lists inside notes.
summary: Jira-style task tracker that manages tasks as markdown files in a two-pane view with custom fields, projects, statuses, and comments.
